Default colors: charcoal with olive green panels, replaced by the character's established costume colors when stated. No lettering. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
